gm_lines: You may maintain three Recorded Oaths simultaneously.
Record a Voluntary Oath — Ritual Time: 1 minute; Range: Touch, or all participants within 10 feet; Cost: 2 Qi

Fulfillment rewards: Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to `4 × PB`; End one lower- or equal-Source-CL oath, fear, charm, restraint, or curse that the fulfillment was meant to resolve; Gain Advantage on one saving throw before the end of the next scene; Receive one truthful symbolic clue concerning the oath’s direct consequences.
Breach: Place Breach Marks equal to your Proficiency Bonus on the breacher. Choose one Recorded Sanction established when the Oath was made.

Compelled Record — Action; Range: Touch; Cost: 7 Qi; Saving Throw: Charisma; Requirement: The target is Completely Subdued, has formally surrendered, has accepted release or aid under stated terms, or is subject to a lawful or conquered authority recognized by the campaign.
Failed Save: The Oath is recorded. Successful Save: The target is not bound and cannot be targeted by your Compelled Record again until the end of the scene.
Target 3+ CL higher: You must also win a Cultivation Check against its save DC. Target 6+ CL lower and Completely Subdued: It automatically fails unless protected by explicit anti-oath authority.

gm_lines: Record the obligation until its stated duration ends, up to 8 hours at this level.

Accepting aid, payment, protection, passage, or an item after its condition is clearly stated counts as acceptance by conduct. A creature may reject a proposed obligation unless another rule lawfully imposes it.

Record Fulfillment or Breach - Reaction; Range 60 feet; Limit once per round; Trigger: A party you can perceive meaningfully fulfills or knowingly breaches one of your recorded obligations. Place one matching Fulfillment or Breach Mark on that creature.

Spend a Fulfillment Mark: Once per turn, spend one Fulfillment Mark on a willing creature to grant one: Add 1d6 to one attack roll, saving throw, or ability check after rolling but before resolution; Move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 2 x PB; Remove one lower- or equal-Source-CL Charmed or Frightened effect tied to fulfilling the obligation; Learn the direction of the obligation's beneficiary or next required destination while within 1 mile.

Spend a Breach Mark: Once per turn, when a marked creature makes a roll, moves, or activates a feature connected to the breached obligation, spend one Breach Mark to choose one: Subtract 1d6 from one attack roll or saving throw; Reduce Speed by 15 feet until the start of your next turn; Prevent Reactions until the start of its next turn; Reveal its direction and distance until the end of the scene while within 1 mile; Grant one beneficiary of the obligation Advantage on its next attack or saving throw against the breacher before the start of your next turn.
A roll can be modified by one Oath Mark.

gm_lines: Invite a minor place-spirit into one unattended object no larger than Large. Choose Guardian, Swift, or Binding Vessel. You may maintain one.

Shared Kami Statistics: Size Object's size, maximum Large; AC 14 + PB; Hit Points 4 x CL; Saving Throws Your Cultivation Save modifiers; Resistance Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing; Immunity Poison/Psychic damage; Charmed, Frightened, Poisoned; Senses Darkvision 60 feet and Qi Sensing 30 feet; Source CL Your CL.
It acts after your turn and Dodges without command. Bonus Action Command: Move and use printed action, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, or Guard.

Guardian Vessel: Speed 30 feet. Guardian Strike: Cultivation Attack, reach 5 feet, 2d8 + key modifier Force or Radiant. Guardian Intercession - Reaction once per round: When an ally within 5 feet takes damage, reduce by PB.

Swift Vessel: Speed 40 feet; Fly 60 feet and Hover; carry up to 50 pounds. Carry the Message - Action: Move a willing Tiny creature or carried object, deliver a talisman/potion/pill/message/tool to a willing creature, or Help at range 10 feet.

Binding Vessel: Speed 20 feet. Binding Cords: Cultivation Attack, range 30 feet, 2d8 + key modifier Force damage. A qualifying spirit/Daemonic/Undead target makes a Charisma save. On failure, Restrained until your next turn and cannot willingly teleport or possess; on success, Speed reduced by 10 feet. Guard: Choose one adjacent willing creature; the Vessel may impose Disadvantage on one attack against it before your next turn.

gm_lines: Manifest Crane Sovereign, Fox Regent, Lantern Judge, or Guardian Hound General. You may maintain ordinary and Greater Shikigami simultaneously.

Shared Greater Statistics: Size Large; AC 15 + PB; Hit Points 7 x CL; Speed 40 feet; Saving Throws Your Cultivation Save modifiers; Resistance Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Necrotic, Radiant; Immunity Poison/Psychic damage; Charmed, Frightened, Poisoned; Senses Truesight 30 feet and Qi Sensing 60 feet; Source CL Your CL.
It acts after your turn and Dodges without command. Bonus Action command Move and Strike, Dash, Disengage, Help, Guard, or form ability.

Greater Spirit Strike: Cultivation Attack, reach 10 feet or range 60 feet chosen on manifestation; 3d8 + key modifier Force, Radiant, or Necrotic. Once per turn against qualifying spirit/Daemonic/Undead targets, add 2d8 Radiant or Force.
Grandmaster Intercession - Reaction once per round: Reduce damage to an ally within 30 feet by 2d8 + key modifier.

Crane Sovereign: Fly 80 feet and Hover. Crossing the Spirit Road: Move one willing creature within 10 feet up to 30 feet without provoking, possibly through open air, but not through barriers, Total Cover, sealed Formations, or spatial locks.

gm_lines: Choose one creature. On a failed save, apply two different Logic Locks. On a successful save, apply one until the start of its next turn.
A creature 3-5 CL lower gains one additional Logic Lock on a failed save. A creature at least 6 CL lower gains all four.
Road Lock: The target cannot willingly teleport, phase, become Incorporeal, or move through another creature's space. Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet.
Technique Lock: Choose one Sphere, Subpath feature family, weapon-delivery system, Domain Armament function, or named technique used by the target during the current scene. It is inaccessible.
Core Lock: Choose one Golden Core Form, Nascent Soul function, Method, Foundation active system, transformation, or Path resource engine. It is suppressed.

Solve a Logic Lock: The target may use an Action and choose one active Lock and one Puzzle Method. Success: Remove that Lock. Success by 5 or more: Remove that Lock and gain a Master Key against your Puzzle features until the end of the scene. Failure: The Lock remains, and the target takes 3d8 Psychic or Force damage.

At the end of each turn, a target within 2 CL of you or higher may attempt one Intelligence save, removing one Lock on success. A target 3-5 CL lower receives this save at the end of every second turn. A target at least 6 CL lower receives no automatic save but always retains the Action-based Solve procedure.

Sacrificial Solution: Before a Solve roll, the target may pay one price to gain Advantage: Spend Cultivation Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus; Accept one level of Exhaustion; Destroy or relinquish a relevant temporary Cultivation Asset; Allow one other active Logic Lock to persist until the end of the scene.
variants.label: Road Lock

gm_lines: Each typed Charge gains an additional benefit when spent. You receive both the normal Spend Calamity benefit and one typed benefit.
Flame: Add 1d8 Fire damage to one damaged target; or Gain Resistance to Fire until the start of your next turn.
Frost: Reduce one damaged target's Speed by 15 feet until the start of your next turn; or Gain Resistance to Cold until the start of your next turn.
Lightning: The damaged target cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn; or Move 15 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
Storm: Push or pull one affected creature 15 feet; or Gain a Fly Speed of 30 feet until the end of the current turn.
Force: Gain +2 AC until the start of your next turn; or Ignore Resistance to Force for one damage roll.
Gravity: Prevent yourself from being moved or knocked Prone until the start of your next turn; or Increase one forced movement by an additional 15 feet.

Blood: Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 3 x your Proficiency Bonus; or The first healing received by one damaged target before the start of your next turn is reduced by twice your Proficiency Bonus.
Shadow: Become Lightly Obscured until the start of your next turn; or Invisible does not conceal one damaged target from you until the start of your next turn.

Spirit: Gain Advantage on saving throws against Charmed, Frightened, possession, and soul displacement until the start of your next turn; or One damaged target has Disadvantage on its next Concentration save before then.
General: Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus; Move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; Add 1d8 Force damage; Add 10 feet to forced movement.
Tempered Body, External Engine: Calamity Tempering is Qi reinforcement and scar cultivation. It does not make the Tribulation Vessel a Body Refiner or grant Body Refining chassis features.
